question: I think the reason this showed up for us now and not on the original may water job, is because we no longer have the much thicker and sloped floor.
method: Direct vertical intersections with triangles in 3D/Objects/object_2.model; coordinates are the saved mesh local frame, before rigid placement. Source CAD independently defines floor_slope_rise = 6.0 and the underside V shifted downward by the 3 mm reservoir wall thickness.
current_geometry: A flat 3 mm floor with 6 mm internal corner fillets; no current geometry change for the walls-only print.
finding: The recovered May native floor is sloped; sampled vertical material thickness is 3 mm, matching the current nominal floor thickness. Its slope changes which strips print on each layer and how the floor joins walls.
causal_limit: A changed floor/path layout is a plausible contributor to different sealing. These geometry readings do not establish the cause of leakage or show that infill outperforms continued perimeters.
